items.title: Startup Helper Parity Pack - make the local /start chain fully executable
items.summary: Session startup still trips over absent optional Studio OS helpers even after the protocol drift sentinel. For a public-unlaunched browser game, this is a launch-confidence problem: every failed helper adds noise before the agent gets to real playability, QA, and founder-blocker evidence.
items.recipe: Add repo-local compatibility helpers for credential-watch, ark drain/ship, router suggest, brief staleness, skill manifest checks, and skill trace emission; keep them honest no-op or local-file implementations, then verify /start helper probes and npm run protocol:drift.

skipped.reason: Still launch-critical, but true PWA install acceptance and real controller feel require owner-device evidence. This audit removes automation noise before that manual gate.
Still the largest replay-trust milestone, but it is larger than a startup repair pass and needs a broader design slice.

evidence: Added repo-local compatibility helpers for credential-watch, Ark drain/ship, router suggestions, brief staleness, skill manifest checks, and skill trace emission
npm run protocol:drift -- --json reports status ok with missingRequired=0 and missingOptional=0
npm run lint clean, npm test 412/412, and npm run build passing
